dedupe_keys.name: hospital overload piecewise smooth capacity model and reproducibility archive

description: This release publishes a capacity-limited hospital-admission model and its reproducibility files. A piecewise-smooth switching law distinguishes demand-limited from capacity-limited operation. The GitHub tree contains Python scripts for equilibrium and stability calculations, periodic-orbit continuation, sensitivity analysis and independent checks. It also lists numerical branch JSON files and one processed aggregate NHS England hospital series for a stock-flow illustration from August 2020 to April 2021. Zenodo identifies an open version 1.0.0 software archive with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21807502 and MIT licence. A modeller could test when admission pressure produces persistent overload cycles or use the archived branches to compare a new implementation. The authors distinguish independently reproduced Hopf and sample-cycle results from fold locations supported by single-shooting residuals without independent collocation. This review did not run the code, inspect the series values or download the archive, so numerical correctness and data transformations remain unverified. The processed NHS series retains the original public source terms, not inheriting the code licence. The generic model is not a measured hospital-capacity inventory. Related resources are the separately sourced NHS England series and hospital-capacity inventories; their terms and coverage should be checked independently before combining them with this model.
